nda.title: Confidentiality agreement
nda.intro: Before opening “{{project}}”, please review and accept the confidentiality terms that cover the files, previews and messages shared in this workspace.
nda.parties: This agreement is between you (the client) and Mustapha Ukizuru (the provider). It covers everything exchanged inside this project workspace.

clauses.title: What is confidential
clauses.body: All deliverables, source files, previews, credentials, messages and documents shared in this workspace, whether or not they are marked confidential.

clauses.title: How it may be used
clauses.body: Only to review, approve and operate the work delivered in this project. It may not be republished, resold or shared outside your organisation without written consent.

clauses.title: What is not covered
clauses.body: Information that is already public, that you already held before this project, or that you receive lawfully from a third party with no duty of confidence.

clauses.title: How long it lasts
clauses.body: The obligations continue for two years after the project closes. Statutory records kept for tax or legal reasons are unaffected.
